text.title: Create a Testnet Card application
text.disclaimer: A Card is never assumed. This wallet-bound flow is Testnet-only and cannot issue a real card, PAN, CVV, balance, fiat funding, or merchant payment.
text.nativeUnavailable: Native Card applications are not available yet
text.nativeDetails: Card applications are not connected in this native app yet. No application can be started here.
text.nativeAuthority: YNX Wallet authorization verifies identity only. It does not create a Card application or authorize funding.
text.connectRequired: Connect a Standard Wallet before starting a Testnet Card application on the web.
text.invalidApplication: The application could not be updated. Review the details and try again.
text.approvalPrepared: Application prepared. A real wallet signature and an accepted sandbox backend receipt are still required.
text.cannotApprove: Wallet approval could not be prepared. Review the application and try again.
text.backendDegraded: The application is paused until an accepted backend receipt is available. No signature, account, active card, balance, or top-up intent was created.
text.cannotSubmit: Sandbox readiness could not be checked. Try again later.
text.risk: I accept Testnet risk and understand this is simulation only.
text.standardRequired: A Standard EVM wallet is required for web applications.
text.draftOnly: Only draft applications can be edited.
text.completeDetails: Enter a nickname of 2–48 characters, a use case of 4–160 characters, and a YNXT limit of at least 1, with up to 6 whole and 6 decimal digits.
text.acceptDetails: Complete the application details and accept the Testnet terms before preparing approval.
text.notAwaiting: This application is not awaiting approval.
text.activeCannotCancel: An active application cannot be cancelled here.
text.storageLoadFailure: The saved application could not be loaded. Try again later.
text.storageSaveFailure: The application could not be saved. Changes may be lost when you leave this screen.
text.cannotCancel: The application could not be cancelled. Try again later.

templates.audit: Audit records: {count}. Only a verified sandbox receipt can activate a Card; top-up stays locked otherwise.
